pages.text: Three vats in a ring, A → B → C → A, the feed hopping on by chances p, q and r. However it starts, it settles into the steady state: time in each vat ∝ $(thing)1/(its chance of leaving)$(). Give a vat three fifths of the time and monazite sand comes out as that vat's product: rare earths, thorium, or phosphate. Make all three equal and warm helium thermalises into $(fluid)Maxwell-Boltzmann Gas$(). The slowest hop sets how fast it mixes.
An $(item)Ergodic Mixer Core$() visits every state there is: its time average is its average over all of them (Kac: a set of measure μ is revisited every t/μ on average).
